Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. s
Heard Mr. Mohd. Azim, learned 
counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Devesh 
Ghildiyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.
According to the meeting of the 
Management Committee of the respondent 
no.4 dated 04.12.2022, the service of the 
petitioner had already been terminated four 
years ago.
Learned counsel for the State 
submitted that according to the instructions, 
received by him from the Department, 
service of the petitioner was not terminated 
as mentioned in the said meeting dated 
04.12.2022.
In the facts and circumstances of this 
case, issue notice to the respondent no.4.
Steps to be taken within a week.
List this case on 25.02.2023.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)

WPSS No. 2432 of 2022
Hon’bleRavindraMaithani, J.
Mohd. Azim, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. for the 
State.
The instant writ petition is against 
termination. State despite opportunity has
failed to file the counter affidavit. Still time 
is sought. 
These are very important matters 
which pertain to the life of the person. The 
services of the petitioner have been 
terminated. The Court may only expect the 
state that public officers should be a little 
more sensitive in such issues.
Let the State file counter affidavit by 
27.07.2023.
List the case on 28.07.2023 as the
first case, after fresh cases, for final 
hearing.
The court makes it clear that no 
extension at any stage, on whatsoever 
ground may be granted.
 (Ravindra Maithani J.)
12.07.2023
Nahid
